rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Three phases: initiation (Cl2 → 2Cl·, light), propagation (Cl· + RH → R· + HCl; R· + Cl2 → RCl + Cl·), termination (radical coupling) — name all three for the mechanism mark.  ·  Trick 2: Anti-Markovnikov addition of HBr in peroxides is a radical chain: Br· adds to the LESS substituted carbon — quote the exception applies to HBr only.
